title: The current look of the bar scene from the first game I developed.
author: RadiantExternal8752
selftext: In my game, which I continue to develop in my spare time from my main job, I wanted to add some dynamism to the bar scene. How does it look visually? I'm open to suggestions.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: Have you looking into using ai to clean off all the dirty artifacts off your images? The background and floor/ chairs have a lot of dirty smudges n whatnot, usually caused from regenerating the same image a lot

replies.author: RadiantExternal8752
replies.body: I honestly don't know how to do that. I also want this kind of image improvement, yes.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body:
Well conveniently I was just testing some prompts today, I'll  drop them here, as I couldn't find anything but some guy scamming by selling the services on his website.  


Just so you know prompt 1 is a bit more extreme and may clean your image a bit too harshly it made my character flat, closer to a vector image, still looked really good but wasn't what I was looking for. Prompt 2 is much more narrow, it didn't fully clean my image 100% (not gonna happen) but I'd say it restored my character about 97% or so, that should be much less noticeable. All in all I was satisfied with how prompt 2 turned out so I haven't pushed for any more refining. If you do add anything additional, or if anyone else tries this, please share results.  I used this with gpt image 2, but the scammer was using Gemini for his results. 


Prompt 1: 

Edit the supplied image without creating a new composition.

Remove AI-generated surface artifacts, including speckles, false grain,
white-dot noise, tiled grime, crunchy microdetail, muddy texture, and
compression-like artifacts.

Preserve the original medium, composition, subject identity, facial
features, anatomy, pose, silhouette, objects, colors, lighting, and edges.

Simplify only unwanted noisy surface detail into clean coherent regions.
Do not add, remove, redesign, or reinterpret anything.
Do not change the image's style.






Prompt 2: 

Remove only random speckles, white-dot noise, repeated texture patterns,
muddy color contamination, and compression-like artifacts.

Preserve all intentional line hatching, blade scratches, material wear,
armor seams, cel-shading marks, and deliberate hand-drawn irregularity.




Let me know if it works out for you. Good luck!

replies.author: RadiantExternal8752
replies.body: Thank you, I will try it as soon as possible and write you the result.

replies.author: RadiantExternal8752
replies.body: Hello, especially with the initial prompt, there's been some progress. Compared to the source image, it reduces the "artificiality" slightly without changing the composition. I haven't yet added and tested this in the game itself, but I think it's a bit better than the situation in the initial source image

replies.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
replies.body: I'm glad to her that progress is being made. You might be able to experiment with the prompt to push it further. You also might be able try a couple of generations. My most success with the prompt is to use it only after a few generations, if I wait too long then too many artifacts get baked in.
